title: Cell Scan
desc: One-shot LTE cell survey: capture a 15.36 MSps burst per carrier, decode MIB/PCFICH/PDCCH/PDSCH/SIB1 offline, and report each cell's PCI, operator (from the PLMN), TAC, cellIdentity + eNB/sector, bandwidth, ports, frequency and receive power. RX-only, no lease at rest - the lease is held only while a scan runs.
